newsitem.title: ZAIRE: Shelling erupts in Goma, east Zaire, witnesses.
newsitem.headline: Shelling erupts in Goma, east Zaire, witnesses.

text.p: Heavy fighting erupted around the eastern Zairean town of Goma on Thursday between rebels and Hutu fighters holed up in the teeming refugee camp of Mugunga, witnesses said.

They said mortar, anti-aircraft and heavy machine-gun fire poured out of the camp. The rebels responded with rockets fired from multiple-barrelled launchers from the strategic Mount Goma overlooking the area.
"There is a lot of heavy fighting, it's impossible to know what is going on," said Reuters correspondent Christian Jennings.
In Goma many more rebels were on the streets. People still moved cautiously around the town, but roadblocks were strengthened and vehicles searched more thoroughly, witnesses said.

Analysts said the Tutsi rebels were most likely stepping up pressure on the camp, home to a hardcore of Hutu militiamen responsible for the 1994 genocide of Tutsis in Rwanda before any international force arrived in the region.
The Hutus fear revenge for the genocide and are apparently putting up a last stand at the Mugunga refugee camp.
